name: Apinata 0.2.0
body:

## What's Changed

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

### Fixes

### Other changes
* Tidy the settings page by @dev in https://github.com/example/apinata/pull/9

## New Contributors

name: Apinata 0.1.1
body:
A **small** fix release.

## What's Changed

- Fix the **proxy** toggle ([#5](https://github.com/example/apinata/pull/5))
- Show `curl` errors in plain words (#6)
- Handle [redirects](https://example.com/docs) again https://github.com/example/apinata/pull/4
### Something new we called it
